verses.sanskrit:
इति वेणुरवं राजन् सर्वभूतमनोहरम् ।
श्रुत्वा व्रजस्त्रियो गोपीः कृष्णस्याकृष्टमानसाः ॥
verses.translation: Thus, O King, hearing the enchanting sound of Krishna's flute that captivates the minds of all beings, the gopis of Vraja were drawn to Krishna.

verses.sanskrit:
बर्हापीडं नटवरवपुः कर्णयोः कर्णिकारं ।
बिभ्रद् वासः कनककपिशं वैजयन्तीं च मालाम् ॥
verses.translation: With a peacock feather adorning His head, dressed as the best of dancers, with karnikara flowers on His ears, wearing golden-hued garments and the Vaijayanti garland.

verses.sanskrit:
रन्ध्रान्  वेणोरधरसुधयाऽपूरयन् गोपवृन्दैः ।
वृन्दारण्यं स्वपदरमणं प्राविशद् गीतकीर्तिः ॥
verses.translation: Filling the holes of the flute with the nectar of His lips, surrounded by cowherd boys, He entered Vrindavana, the land beautified by His footprints, His glories being sung.
